title: Sam Fox School announces new Carmon Colangelo award program
summary_en: Trustee and WashU alumna Vicki Match Suna has made a pledge to establish and endow the Carmon Colangelo Award for Creative Research and Innovation at the WashU Sam Fox School.
title_cn: Sam Fox School announces new Carmon Colangelo award program

title: Weihl named inaugural Gabe Weil Professor
summary_en: Conrad C. Weihl, MD, PhD, a leading expert in the genetic mechanisms of neuromuscular disorders such as muscular dystrophy, has been installed as the inaugural Gabe Weil Professor in the Department of Neurology at WashU Medicine.
title_cn: Weihl named inaugural Gabe Weil Professor

title: WashU hosts Declaration celebration
summary_en: WashU Libraries host “Unalienable Rights: America at 250,” a celebration of the 250th anniversary of the nation’s founding, at 2 p.m. July 2 at Olin Library. The free event features a talk about the Declaration and children’s activities.
